XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Slowed rotation of the starter motor when starting with a cold engine.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Ignition system

  • Device: Starter motor

  • Fault: Occasionally, on the first attempt to start the engine when it is warm, the engine fails to start.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0335 (Crankshaft Position Sensor 1 - Generic Fault)

  • Cause: Faulty starter motor

• Action: Check that the starter motor is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located between the engine and the radiator, on the driver’s side; accessible from underneath the vehicle.
